name: didim-mcp
description: Use Didim MCP with your Microsoft account. The plugin registers the hosted Didim MCP server and Codex runs the OAuth sign-in; no API key is ever entered. Skill workflows are published from the Didim Skill Registry, so they update without reinstalling the plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Use Didim MCP tools with your Microsoft account.
interface.longDescription: Registers the hosted Didim MCP server and ships thin router skills that fetch their working procedure from the Didim Skill Registry at run time — so a workflow change is published by an operator, not shipped as a plugin update. Codex runs the Microsoft OAuth sign-in for you, so there is no API key to create, copy, or paste. Skills read the connection state from the tools exposed to the session, report the signed-in account, and walk through sign-in when it is needed. Only the tools you enabled in the Didim portal are exposed.
